BPPE_charge_definition.definition: EDC94844 defines institutional charges as charges for an educational program paid directly to an institution. EDC94850 distinguishes required program charges paid directly to another entity. CCR71800(e)(7) expressly lists in-resident housing among institutional charges. Thus housing receipts/refunds need conditional selection, not blanket application to independent student tenancies.

source_reasoning.school_boundary: Current official CCR1859.2 defines Interim Housing as temporary Classrooms and ancillary school facilities. School Facility Program grant calculations concern educational capacity/site improvements. This is an eligible-use distinction, not missing customer facts or lack of known award.
